ownership.quote: StateSet connects commerce systems, business rules and AI-assisted workflows so teams can spend less time chasing exceptions and more time moving work to resolution.

stage.note: No funding round, investor, or accelerator disclosure found on the company site, GitHub, or via ycombinator.com/companies/stateset (404, not a YC company). Crunchbase/Tracxn/PitchBook profiles for 'stateset' returned no accessible page (404/403) during research; LinkedIn required login. StateSet's iCommerce product (which includes 'StateSet Sandbox') markets itself as an AI commerce-operations platform with a SOC 2 Type II report and enterprise customers, consistent with an operating, revenue-generating independent company, but no funding figures could be confirmed or credibly estimated in the time available.

note: StateSet, Inc. is a San Francisco-area (phone area code 650) company operating stateset.com, an 'AI execution plane for commerce operations' (order/returns/refund/subscription automation, SOC 2 Type II audited). sandbox.stateset.app ('StateSet Sandbox') is a developer sandbox product offered under the same brand (same logo/org, linked from stateset.com's Developers > Sandboxes nav). No press releases, funding announcements, investor names, accelerator batch, or revenue figures were found on the company's own site, blog, or GitHub org; general web search engines (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google) were inaccessible or returned unrelated/blocked results during this research session, and Crunchbase/PitchBook/LinkedIn profile pages could not be read (login walls / 403s). A distinct historical 'stateset.io' domain existed circa 2019-2020 (per Wayback Machine index) but its content could not be verified as the same entity, so it is not used as evidence here. Treat funding/stage/investors/revenue as genuinely unresearched rather than confirmed-absent.
